_README: SHIPPED DEFAULT — deliberately HIDDEN. 'verified' is false, so js/lottery.js keeps the home-page lottery panel hidden and no numbers are shown. This is on purpose: a fresh checkout has never run the daily workflow, and the site must NEVER display unverified or placeholder numbers as a real draw. The GitHub Action (.github/workflows/lottery-update.yml) runs tools/update-lottery.mjs once a day, fetches the real draw from the official operator feed, and OVERWRITES this file with verified:true data — only then does the panel appear. See data/README.md for the full contract, and data/lottery.sample.json for an example of what a verified run produces. JSON has no comments; _note_* keys are ignored by the renderer.
_note_verified: GATE. The panel renders ONLY when this is exactly true. Set to true ONLY by tools/update-lottery.mjs after a successful fetch from the official operator feed. Never hand-set it to true.
_note_game: Plain game name shown on the panel and drawn into the own-made SVG badge. Free text.
_note_drawNumber: Integer draw number. Shown as 'Draw 4512'. Omit or null to hide. The value here is a placeholder — the panel is hidden while verified is false.
_note_drawDate: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the draw. Rendered in en-AU long form.
_note_winningNumbers: Array of the main winning numbers, in draw order. EMPTY in this shipped default — no numbers are shown until the workflow writes a verified draw.
_note_supplementary: Optional array of supplementary numbers. Rendered as outlined balls after a divider. Use [] or omit if the game has none.
_note_powerball: Optional single Powerball number (for the Powerball game). null/omit for other games.
_note_jackpot: Optional free-text line under the numbers. Omit to hide.
_note_badgeColour: Colour of the own-made SVG badge. MUST be one of the site palette: #E1251B (red), #111111 (black) or #FF6E63 (red-on-dark). Anything else is snapped back to #E1251B by the renderer.
_note_logoSlot: OPTIONAL local asset path under assets/lottery/ for a badge image the owner is licensed to use (e.g. 'assets/lottery/game-badge.svg'). LOCAL FILES ONLY — never an external URL, never a trademarked lottery logo. Left empty (the default), the panel draws its own SVG badge from game + badgeColour. Preserved verbatim by the workflow across refreshes.
_note_posterSlot: OPTIONAL local asset path under assets/lottery/ for an owner-supplied poster image (e.g. 'assets/lottery/current-poster.jpg'). LOCAL FILES ONLY. If the file is missing or empty, the poster slot hides itself cleanly. Preserved verbatim by the workflow across refreshes.
_note_ctaHref: Optional link for the 'Check your numbers' button. Omit to hide the button.
_note_updated: Optional ISO timestamp of when this file was last refreshed. Shown as a small 'Updated …' note.
